description: Effective TY2027 wage band edges in dollars for transport.quantile_map@2. Each edge is the wage table's TY2026 cut in cents times the selected profile's P1 factor over 100, computed exactly and rounded once to binary64. Band counts stay the TY2026 IRD facts the references pin: scaling the edges, not the mapped values, keeps one producer of person.employment_income (design 80, section 2). The generator's --check recomputes every edge from reference_intervals.json and reference_aging.json.
tail_disclosure: R2C-9: the central tail fits grouped_pareto_mle@1 to the ten $50,000 bands from $500,000 plus the open top; VPT re-anchors at $300,000 over all fourteen $50,000 bands plus the top. The two-point closed form is a G8-x diagnostic and is not declared here.
